messages:
Alex: FYI getting a flurry of cost-attribution alerts for EU GPU pool. Grafana shows spikes but traces in Jaeger/OTel missing node/service tags so billing groups to _unknown_. Anyone else seeing this?

Sophie: Hmm — which trace ids? Is this after the gateway change yesterday?

Alex: example trace: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01
I grabbed the span list and most runtime spans lack resource.attributes['redwood.node_id'] and 'service.name'. Logs show header truncation on the ingress -> gateway hop.

Dmitri: That trace header looks like it's being clipped. We recently enabled Vary: Accept and some proxy libs cap combined header size at 8k. Envoy has --max-request-headers-kb. Can we check current value?

Alex: Envoy shows 60 (KB) on dedicated, but gateway pods are at default 8. Repro steps I used:
```
curl -v -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" \
  -H "baggage: nodeid=eu-gpu-23;long=... (payload)" https://gateway.internal/api/v1/infer
```
Response headers: `baggage` trimmed, and runtime logs: `otel: missing resource attr service.name` on span export.

Joy: Oof. That would explain both the missing service and the billing misjoin. Short-term: can we patch runtime to synthesize node_id from instance metadata when baggage absent? Long-term: increase header kb on gateway and add a test for header-size in ingress e2e.

Dmitri: Agreed. Two PRs then: (1) runtime fallback for resource attrs (low risk) assigned to @Dmitri; (2) infra change to set envoy max-request-headers-kb=64 for gateway, assigned to @Sophie. Also need a Grafana alert tweak: change the PromQL that groups by `service` to fall back to `node_id` using label_replace or join on request_id.

Sophie: I'll do the envoy change in canary tomorrow 08:30 UTC and monitor. Will add a rollout note. Also adding an ad-hoc dashboard panel: ratio of spans with missing `service.name` over last 1h.

Alex: Adding ops ticket: OPS-9123. I'll attach trace samples and timeline. For tracking — tagging as `priority:high` and `impact:billing`.

ops-bot: Created OPS-9123 (https://issues.redwood/OPS-9123) assigned to Dmitri, Sophie. Note: include test steps and rollout playbook.

Joy: Also consider tail-sampling config — we should prefer sampling traces that hit heavy GPU endpoints so we don't miss the long tail where service attrs matter for billing.

Dmitri: I'll include a quick tail-based policy matching resources with `attribute redwood.component == "gpu-runtime"` and keep rate 100/s.

Alex: Thanks — looks like a decent plan. Please post PR links here when ready so I can validate with example traces.

Sophie: will do. :thumbsup: 

Dmitri: PRs created: runtime fallback (https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/482) and envoy knob (https://git.redwood/infra/pull/210). Leaving notes on canary checks.

Alex: Verified after merge to staging: span samples now have `redwood.node_id` for the sample traces I tried. Monitor for 1h.

Joy: Keeping an eye — will escalate if Grafana ratio doesn't drop below 0.5 in 30m.

Alex: update — ratio down to 0.2 after 25m. Nice work :tada:
